how: tools/anm-flag-writes.py walks each handler of a title and records every write to the two flag words of that title, whose offsets are measured - 0x18 and 0x1c in titles 13 and 14, 0x530 and 0x534 in 16 and 17, 0x534 and 0x538 in 18 - with the shapes of 331 to 334: argument bit, immediate, register, and a write through a register a lea rows for the pair of a title, and for the one word a whole-dispatch sweep showed beside the pair in titles 13 and 14
